show.description: A group of travelers becomes trapped inside an abandoned jungle hotel where terrifying events begin after sunset. While others mock his warnings, Rahul believes deadly man-eating ants are hiding in the darkness. As betrayals, fear, and panic spread through the group, the creatures close in, turning the night into a brutal fight for survival. In the end, the real danger may not just be outside, but within the group itself.
